integrity: Mathematical proof uses a unique row/column normal form; finite experiments are independently reproducible but are not the basis of the general theorem. Priority is qualified by possible unindexed literature; no independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to labelled transitive binary relations satisfying explicitly stated Fischer–Servi forward and backward confluence on finite rooted stars with at least one leaf. No seriality or reflexivity is imposed; unlabelled orbit counts and general posets are outside scope. Auxiliary transitive-relation counts are exact finite invariants rather than closed elementary formulas.
title: Transitive Fischer–Servi relations on rooted stars: a structural decomposition and exact census
